briefing.text: News: Information Technology still leads buzz at 86.9 (+0.9 on the day, -1.5 over the week), with mentions up 17% and flat sentiment (-0.03), driven by NVDA, MSFT, AMD. Materials (+1.2) and Communication Services (+1.1, mentions +27%) gained most; Real Estate fell 2.2 (mentions -20%) and Energy 0.7. Financials are up 4.1 on the week. X: IT leads at 93.5 (mentions +18%, sentiment 0.10, NVDA, MU, AMD); the big jumps in small sectors (Basic Materials +27.8) rest on a single ticker, RML. Reddit: IT buzz 94.8 (mentions +48%, NVDA, ANT, AAPL), Health Care rose from rank 7 to 4 (+4.6, mentions +300%, SLS, MRNA, DARE), while Financial Services mentions fell 48%.

INTU #1: Headlines are mostly negative (16 of 21 articles) alongside a drop of about 7% before earnings on 11-19, so the news fits the ranking.
DIS #2: Morgan Stanley raised its price target to $133 and coverage is mostly positive (53 of 98); this supports the high attention.
KLAR #3: Earnings-call coverage on US growth and margins plus a KLAR vs AFRM comparison; positive tilt (18 of 37) and the stock is up 12% over 5 days.
WDAY #4: Headlines on an enterprise AI tie-up; the larger driver looks like the 5.8% drop, with earnings due 11-24 and a Silver Lake takeover market at 14%.
TTWO #5: Grand Theft Auto VI begins global rollout with reports of strong preorders and reviews; this explains the attention despite a 10% 5-day fall.
HD #6: Lowe's raised its annual sales forecast, putting home-improvement names in the news; this helps explain attention on HD (137 articles).
HOOD #9: Kalshi plans to offer stock and ETF trading, framed as a threat to Robinhood; headlines are mostly negative and the stock is down 15% over 5 days.
NVDA #10: Coverage (1,691 articles) centers on a delayed 10-Q filing and a Michael Burry comment, plus CEO-related prediction markets; this adds to the ranking.

INTU ranks first on attention 1.47x normal and X attention 1.80x normal, a 2.9-sigma price move (down 7.2%) and an earnings catalyst on 11-19, although volume is only 0.23x normal. DIS is second on attention 1.58x and X attention 1.55x, with volume 1.07x normal, and active Kalshi app-download markets. KLAR is third with the strongest attention readings in the top three (2.57x, X 2.82x), volume 1.16x normal and a 1.4-sigma move after a 12% 5-day gain. Attention and X attention carry 70% of the score, so these three lead on attention.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
